arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Highlights
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

I am writing to share the latest market data relevant to Acme’s Q1 performance. Please find below the key highlights from our client briefing records:

- Category share (protein bars):
  • January: 18.4% (up 60bps QoQ, driven by club channel reset – Nielsen scanner, Q4–Q1 pull)
  • February: 18.6% (share holding, Verdant flat – Nielsen scanner, February)
  • March: 18.9% (share continuing to grow, Verdant flat-to-down – Nielsen scanner, March)

- Retail velocity (protein bar SKU):
  • January: 4.7 units/store/week (steady, top-3 SKU – IRI scan)
  • February: 4.9 units/store/week (uptick, Q1 promo driving trial – IRI scan)
  • March: 5.1 units/store/week (best Q1 reading, momentum continues – IRI scan)

- Regional momentum:
  • Southeast: +12% YoY (strongest region, pull-through from Walmart reset)
  • West: +8% YoY (below plan +12%, competitive pressure from private label)
  • Northeast: +9% YoY (steady, no notable competitive shifts)

- Promo lift:
  • January: +22% during MLK weekend reset (outperformed planned +15%)
  • February: +18% during Super Bowl window (met plan)

- Digital share of voice:
  • February: 33%
  • March: 34% (steady leadership, recommend hold spend in Q2)

If you need further breakdown or have specific questions about the data, please let me know.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group
